questions.id: verify-是否建立覆盖功能-性能-可靠性-合规的测试矩阵-并与-entry-exit-对齐

text.zh: 是否建立覆盖功能/性能/可靠性/合规的测试矩阵，并与 Entry/Exit 对齐？
text.en: Do we have a test matrix covering function, performance, reliability, and compliance that aligns with Entry/Exit gates?

zh.1: 无测试矩阵，测试科目依赖经验安排。
zh.2: 按经验挑选测试科目，矩阵覆盖与门槛未定义。
zh.3: 建立测试矩阵并列出覆盖项，但 Entry/Exit 或判定阈值未完全对齐。
zh.4: 测试矩阵与 Entry/Exit、停线规则对齐，异常有闭环机制。
zh.5: 测试数据回写到规则库，矩阵覆盖率与缺口动态维护。

en.1: No test matrix; test items are scheduled based on experience.
en.2: Tests are chosen by experience; matrix coverage and thresholds are undefined.
en.3: Test matrix exists with coverage listed, but Entry/Exit or thresholds are not fully aligned.
en.4: Test matrix aligns with Entry/Exit and line-stop rules with closure on anomalies.
en.5: Test data feeds the rules library, maintaining coverage and gaps dynamically.

questions.id: verify-是否具备关键实验室-仪器-emc-安规-esd-热像-相机-sfr-射频-或合格外部实验室

text.zh: 是否具备关键实验室/仪器（EMC/安规/ESD/热像/相机 SFR/射频）或合格外部实验室？
text.en: Do we have critical labs/instruments (EMC, safety, ESD, thermal imaging, camera SFR, RF) or qualified external labs?

zh.1: 缺乏关键实验室或仪器，能力无法满足需求。
zh.2: 部分仪器具备但校准或资质缺失，外部资源无评估。
zh.3: 关键实验室或外部资质明确，仪器清单与校准记录可追溯。
zh.4: 仪器能力与维护计划闭环，产能与排期满足项目需求。
zh.5: 实验室能力指标化管理，容量与质量数据驱动资源规划。

en.1: Critical labs or instruments are missing; capability cannot meet needs.
en.2: Some instruments exist but calibration or accreditation is missing, and external resources are unevaluated.
en.3: Critical labs or external qualifications are defined with traceable instrument lists and calibration records.
en.4: Instrument capability and maintenance plans are closed loop; capacity and scheduling meet project demand.
en.5: Lab capability is metric-driven; capacity and quality data drive resource planning.

questions.id: verify-是否开展环境与寿命测试-alt-高低温循环-高湿-盐雾-汗液-并建立寿命预测模型

text.zh: 是否开展环境与寿命测试（ALT/高低温循环/高湿/盐雾/汗液），并建立寿命预测模型？
text.en: Do we run environmental and life tests (ALT, thermal cycling, high humidity, salt fog, sweat) and build a life prediction model?

zh.1: 无环境或寿命测试计划，风险未识别。
zh.2: 零散开展环境或寿命测试，缺方法与记录。
zh.3: 执行 ALT/高低温/盐雾等测试，并保留数据与判定标准。
zh.4: 建立寿命预测模型，与测试数据比对闭环并形成改进。
zh.5: 寿命模型与量产监控联动，数据驱动策略调整与预警。

en.1: No environmental or life test plan; risks are unidentified.
en.2: Environmental or life tests are sporadic with missing methods and records.
en.3: ALT, thermal cycling, and salt fog tests are executed with retained data and criteria.
en.4: Life prediction model established with closed-loop comparison to test data and improvements logged.
en.5: Life model ties into mass-production monitoring to drive strategy adjustments and alerts.

questions.id: verify-rf-ota-暗室是否能完成-trp-tis-测试-仿真与实测的相关性如何证明

text.zh: RF/OTA 暗室是否能完成 TRP/TIS 测试？仿真与实测的相关性如何证明？
text.en: Can the RF/OTA chamber complete TRP/TIS testing, and how is correlation to simulation demonstrated?

zh.1: 无 OTA 能力或无报告
zh.2: 有测试记录，方法/校准/相关性缺失
zh.3: 可完成 TRP/TIS，相关性有初步对比
zh.4: 方法规范，相关性阈值明确且稳定达标
zh.5: 常态化相关性监控与模型回归；结构变更触发复核

en.1: No OTA capability or reports available.
en.2: Test records exist, but methods, calibration, or correlation are missing.
en.3: TRP/TIS can be completed with initial correlation comparisons.
en.4: Methods are standardised with clear, consistently met correlation thresholds.
en.5: Correlation is monitored routinely with model regression; structural changes trigger rechecks.

en.2: Subjects are scattered with missing methods and calibration.
en.3: Major subjects can be produced with essentially compliant methods and calibration.
en.4: Full subject coverage with traceable, repeatable data.
en.5: Closed loop with mass-production ORT/scenario data (trend/drift monitoring with rule updates).
